messages:
Sofia L: Quick check — Helix private/VPC deploy window is confirmed for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Who's on primary, who is secondary, and can we confirm rollback readiness? I will do the post-deploy smoke review. @Keegan B @Ram P @Alice C :spiral_calendar:

Keegan B: I can take primary deploy. I have the playbook and canary slices ready. Target cadence: canary -> 25% -> 100% over ~20m. Need DB migration timing from @Alice C.

Alice C: DB migration is a safe online migration (no downtime) but we'll cut a schema flag first. Migration PR is merged, migration runs as part of step 4. I recommend running the migration only after canary is green.

Jordan M: On smoke tests — I'll run the smoke suite from the customer network and from a control plane node. Smoke checklist (quick):
- auth/login
- streaming inference basic prompt
- KV cache warm
- tail logs for OOM/errors

Use this quick command from ops host:```bash
./scripts/helix_smoke.sh --target canary --wait 120
```

Ram P: I'll be standby for routing and VPN. Confirmed firewall rules are in the change ticket (ingress from customer CIDR allowed on required ports). Rollback plan: revert route table to previous vpc-peering, and run DB schema rollback script if needed (we have DB snapshot at T-5m). I'll monitor BGP sessions during cutover.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: Change window reserved by Sofia L for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Pager schedule: Keegan B (primary), Ram P (network), Jordan M (smoke), Alice C (db). 15-minute preflight at 01:45 UTC.

Keegan B: Preflight items I'll run at 01:45 UTC:
- verify pre-deploy health: `curl -sS http://canary/health | jq .`
- check node CPU/GPU free via `kubectl top nodes`
- confirm autoscale policy in console

Sofia L: Two quick asks before we close: 1) Keegan, can you push the small CLI improvement in the deploy script (timeout bump from 30s->90s)? 2) Alice, confirm migration has a toggle so we can abort safely.

Alice C: Migration has an opt-out flag. Example to abort: `./migrate --abort --reason "rollback"`. I also attached the migration runbook in the ticket.

Keegan B: Pushed the timeout change to `deploy.sh` on main (PR #742). I will tag the deploy with `helix-20260318`.

DeployBot: Preflight checks: config lint -> pass, canary image resolved -> ok, infra limits -> ok. No blockers reported.

Sofia L: Perfect. We'll meet async — 01:45 UTC preflight. If anyone can't make the window, call out now. Otherwise I'll post a final GO/NO-GO message 15m prior. :thumbsup:
